name: MamaSuds
description: US maker of non-toxic, plant-and-mineral-based home cleaning products — laundry detergent, dish soap and household cleaners — sold direct through its own website.

evidence.summary: MamaSuds' own affiliate program page states affiliates earn 20% of MamaSuds purchases made through their affiliate link, that you must be a MamaSuds customer to be an affiliate, and that conversions are not counted toward renewing subscriptions; the program runs on UpPromote and pays a given month's earnings at the end of the following month.

The same official page answers its FAQ 'Is there a monthly earning cap?' with: 'Nope. We are more than happy to pay out whatever you have earned in a given month!' — an explicit no-earnings-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.
The page states up front that the program is an affiliate program and explicitly NOT a multi-level marketing program: affiliates earn only from sales directly tied to their own link.

reasons.niche_fit: Non-toxic home cleaning staples are a staple home/UGC demo category (laundry and cleaning routines film well).
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open affiliate program aimed at customers-creators exists on the official site, but no large published creator cohort or UGC campaign evidence was found.
reasons.compensation: Published 20% commission on the brand's own page plus an explicit no-monthly-earning-cap FAQ answer — top band for this group.
reasons.contact_access: A public program page with signup via UpPromote, but no public affiliate contact email was published (the page's email was masked in retrieval).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open signup, but restricted: affiliates must already be MamaSuds customers and the program is US-only, with subscription renewals excluded.
reasons.credibility: Established direct-to-consumer cleaning brand with its own storefront and an explicitly anti-MLM program statement.

name: Mixtiles
description: Photo-printing brand that turns phone photos into stickable, damage-free wall tiles and framed prints, ordered through its website and app.

evidence.summary: Mixtiles' own Creator Program page (creators.mixtiles.com) offers creators 20% commission on every sale made through their ambassador link, plus monthly view bonuses for TikTok and Instagram content, ad-spend bonuses and free product; it is open to US-based creators and does not require a large following.
The creator program page publishes creators@mixtiles.com as the program contact.

The page's line about top creators earning $10,000-$15,000+ per month is an earnings projection, not a cap statement; no earnings cap is stated anywhere on the page, so commission_cap stays unknown (not uncapped).

reasons.niche_fit: Photo tiles are a highly visual home-decor product built for before/after wall content — near-perfect UGC fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated creator program that pays extra monthly bonuses for TikTok/Instagram views shows structured, ongoing creator collaboration.
reasons.compensation: Published 20% commission plus view and ad-spend bonuses and free product; no cap is stated, so it is not scored as uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated creator portal plus a published program email (creators@mixtiles.com) — top band.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application for US-based creators with no large-following requirement stated.
reasons.credibility: Large, well-known direct-to-consumer photo brand with mainstream retail/app presence.

name: Hiboy
description: Electric mobility brand selling commuter e-scooters, e-bikes and riding accessories direct through hiboy.com.

evidence.summary: Hiboy's own affiliate page presents its affiliate program (ShareASale and AvantLink network logos shown; the brand's Canadian page states ShareASale explicitly) and publishes affiliate@hiboy.com as the program contact.

Third-party listings conflict on the rate: Lasso lists 8% flat, Hiboy's Canadian page says 'up to 8%' (a ceiling), and an ambassador listing says 6% — so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than guessing.
Rateful's TikTok Shop analysis estimates roughly 94% of Hiboy's TikTok Shop sales come through affiliate creators — strong evidence the brand sells heavily through creator content.

reasons.niche_fit: E-scooters and e-bikes are core tech/commuter-review content with strong demo value.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Rateful estimates ~94% of the brand's TikTok Shop sales are affiliate-creator driven — among the strongest UGC signals in this group.
reasons.compensation: A real network program exists but published rates conflict (8% flat vs up to 8% vs 6%), so the rate is null and compensation scores mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate contact email on the brand's own program page plus network signup routes.
reasons.credibility: Established e-mobility brand with its own storefront and multi-network affiliate presence.

name: Heybike
description: Electric bike brand established in 2021 selling folding, commuter, step-through and fat-tire e-bikes and accessories direct through heybike.com.

evidence.summary: Heybike's own affiliate page says applicants apply via Impact or AvantLink ('Heybike's affiliate network partner'), that the program terms are the same across all networks, and publishes affiliate@heybike.com for questions.

Rates conflict across the brand's own surfaces and listings: the Heybike Sports subdomain says 'Earn 5% commission', Awin's UK profile says 'up to 5%' (a ceiling), and an older network listing showed 3% (now inactive) — so commission_rate is null.

reasons.niche_fit: Affordable e-bikes are a proven review/demo category for tech and outdoor creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand recruits influencers and creators through its network programs (its Awin profile explicitly seeks social media influencers and creators), but no quantified creator-sales evidence was published.
reasons.compensation: Program is real and network-run, but the rate is unpublished on the main page and conflicts across sources (5% vs up to 5% vs 3%), so it is recorded null.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate email on the brand's own page plus two network application routes.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open applications via Impact or AvantLink with identical terms.
reasons.credibility: Established 2021 e-bike brand with US/EU storefronts and multi-network programs.

name: Segway
description: Segway-Ninebot's US store selling self-balancing transporters, electric scooters, e-bikes and accessories.

evidence.summary: Segway's official affiliate program page (retrieved via search crawl; the page itself renders as a JS shell) states affiliates join through ShareASale, CJ or AvantLink, with a 3-10% commission range and a 30-day cookie.
Third-party listings conflict inside the brand's own stated range (3% vs 6%), and a range is not a single rate — so commission_rate is recorded as null.

reasons.niche_fit: Flagship e-scooter/transporter brand — a core tech-review niche with high-ticket products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Runs creator-relevant network programs on three major networks, but no published creator cohort or UGC campaign data was found.
reasons.compensation: Only a 3-10% range is published and listings conflict within it, so the rate is null and compensation scores mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate contact email was found; the route is the program page and network signup.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open applications through three major affiliate networks.
reasons.credibility: One of the best-known personal-mobility brands in the world, sold through its own US store.

name: Goal Zero
description: Portable power brand founded in 2009 selling solar generators, power stations, solar panels and lighting for outdoor, off-grid and home-backup use.

evidence.summary: An October 2026 check of Goal Zero's official program page reports a dynamic commission of up to 10%, a 30-day cookie, average order value above $600, creative assets and an affiliate manager, with the program managed through Partnerize.

Rate sources conflict: Partnerize's own blog lists Goal Zero at 2% commission, the official page describes a dynamic rate of up to 10% (a ceiling), and Lasso lists 5% — so commission_rate is recorded as null.

reasons.niche_fit: Portable power stations and solar gear are a strong tech/outdoor review niche with very high order values.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A managed network program with an affiliate manager exists, but no published creator-content evidence was found.
reasons.compensation: Dynamic rate described only as 'up to 10%' on the official page and conflicting figures elsewhere (2%, 5%), so the rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: No public program contact email or direct application URL could be verified; joining runs through Partnerize/Ascend.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open through Partnerize, but the application route is not published on a brand page we could fetch.
reasons.credibility: Category-defining portable power brand founded in 2009 with global distribution.

name: Ride1Up
description: Direct-to-consumer e-bike brand selling commuter, cruiser and off-road electric bikes through ride1up.com, with average order values around $1,500.

evidence.summary: Ride1Up runs a brand-direct Partner Program at partners.ride1up.com (on the Tune platform, per the brand's own support docs) and publishes partners@ride1up.com as the program contact.

The brand's own surfaces conflict: its affiliate page highlights a 5% base commission with a 30-day cookie and ~$1,500 AOV, while its Ambassador agreement states 8% of the net final sales price — two documented tracks, so commission_rate is null. The program also carries a $500 payout minimum via PayPal.

reasons.niche_fit: Value e-bikes are a solid tech/commuter review niche, slightly narrower than scooters.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured partner/ambassador program exists on the brand's own portal, with no published creator-sales data.
reasons.compensation: Two conflicting brand-published rates (5% base vs 8% ambassador) and a high $500 payout minimum, so the rate is null and compensation is mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Published partners@ email plus a dedicated partner portal — strong access.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open partner application, though the $500 payout minimum slows first payouts.
reasons.credibility: Established US direct-to-consumer e-bike brand with its own storefront and support docs.

name: Zulay Kitchen
description: Family-owned kitchenware brand selling affordable kitchen gadgets and tools — frothers, juicers, utensils and cookware accessories — through zulaykitchen.com, Amazon and TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: Zulay Kitchen's own Ambassador page invites creators to join its Ambassador Program to 'earn commissions' creating content with its products, with free products, exclusive campaigns and early access; its Collabs page likewise offers affiliate commission partnerships with an application form.
The brand publishes official Affiliate & Reward Terms and Conditions on zulaykitchen.com confirming an official affiliate/reward program; the terms publish no commission rate.

Rateful estimates about 94% of Zulay Kitchen's TikTok Shop sales (30 days to Nov 3, 2026) came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs — the brand sells heavily through creator content on TikTok Shop.
Lasso lists 'up to 10.5%' for Zulay Kitchen, which is a rate ceiling, not a published rate, and the brand's own pages publish no rate — so commission_rate is null.

reasons.niche_fit: Kitchen gadgets are a top-performing home UGC category (quick demo videos).
reasons.ugc_evidence: Rateful estimates ~94% of the brand's TikTok Shop sales are affiliate-creator driven, and the brand runs its own ambassador/collabs programs.
reasons.compensation: Programs are real but no commission rate is published anywhere on the brand's own pages (only a third-party 'up to 10.5%' ceiling), so the rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: Public collabs/ambassador application pages on the official site, but no published contact email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open ambassador and collabs applications on the official site.
reasons.credibility: Established family-owned kitchenware brand with its own storefront plus Amazon and TikTok Shop distribution.

name: Springland Pets
description: Women- and family-owned pet brand (formerly Springer) selling dog walking and travel essentials — travel water bottles, waterproof leashes and accessories — through springlandpets.com; featured on Shark Tank.

evidence.summary: Springland Pets' own site FAQ answers 'Does Springland have an affiliate program?' with 'Yes we do!' and links the application portal at springlandaffiliate.superfiliate.com — a brand-direct affiliate program on Superfiliate. The same page confirms the brand was formerly named Springer.
No commission rate is published on the brand's public pages, so commission_rate is null.

reasons.niche_fit: Dog walking/travel essentials are a natural fit for pet UGC (walk and travel demos).
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's travel bottle is a known viral-style pet product and it runs an open affiliate portal, but no quantified creator evidence was published.
reasons.compensation: Program confirmed on the brand's own site, but no rate is published, so compensation scores on access rather than pay data.
reasons.contact_access: Direct application portal linked from the brand's own FAQ; no public contact email found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open signup through the Superfiliate portal.
reasons.credibility: Established pet brand with national press (Shark Tank, Wirecutter, Forbes logos shown on its site) and its own storefront.

name: Casely
description: Brooklyn-born phone accessories brand founded in 2017 by siblings Emily and Mark Stallings, selling fashionable protective phone cases and accessories through getcasely.com.

evidence.summary: Casely's own affiliate page invites affiliates to 'sign up & earn tiered commission' promoting its cases and accessories, with signup routed to ShareASale, and states: 'Tiered commission on sales tracked through ShareASale.'

Rate figures conflict: Awin's Casely profile advertises 'up to 20% commission' (a ceiling) while Shopper lists 5-10%, and the brand's own page publishes no numbers — so commission_rate is null. The Awin profile publishes jeremy@getcasely.com for partnership inquiries.

reasons.niche_fit: Fashion phone cases are a proven accessories UGC category (haul and drop-test content).
reasons.ugc_evidence: An own-site affiliate program targeting bloggers, vloggers and publications, plus listings on multiple networks — active creator/publisher recruitment.
reasons.compensation: Tiered commission is confirmed by the brand but unpublished, and third-party figures conflict (up to 20% vs 5-10%), so the rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnership email (jeremy@getcasely.com) plus an own-site program page with network signup.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via ShareASale from the brand's own page.
reasons.credibility: Established 2017 Brooklyn accessories brand with its own storefront and multi-network presence.
